entities.summary: The Théâtre Déjazet is a theatre on the boulevard du Temple in the 3rd arrondissement of Paris, France. Théâtre Déjazet is the only theatre surviving on the boulevard du Temple, not destroyed by Georges-Eugène Haussmann.
